frequency_question: How often do similar major election integrity bills pass the Senate when pursued by their proponents?
membership_rule: Includes major federal bills targeting voter registration requirements, ID rules, or citizenship verification introduced since 1995. Excludes minor technical amendments and non-binding resolutions.

cases.name: Help America Vote Act (HAVA) provisions on ID
SAFE Act / PROVE Act separate legislative pushes
For the People Act / Freedom to Vote Act senate votes
SAVE Act standalone house passage and senate consideration attempts

coverage_note: 6 named representative legislative pushes over three decades; captures the high bar of Senate rules for voter registration bills.
known_gaps: Minor committee-level votes excluded as they did not reach the full Senate floor test.
skeleton: Legislative cycles for major partisan electoral integrity bills in polarized Senates (divided government or filibuster constraints)
multiplier: 6 historical major partisan attempts / cycles identified; 1 successfully incorporated into broader major legislation (HAVA compromise) while 5 standalone or strict partisan bills failed due to senate thresholds and filibuster.
validity_reason: Senate filibuster rules and broad polarization patterns remain stable over this medium-term horizon.
